name: Sit-to-stand from a chair
cues: Feet hip-width, sit at the front of the chair; lean forward and stand up without using your hands; sit down slowly.

name: Bodyweight squat
cues: Feet shoulder-width; sit hips back and down, knees follow your toes, chest up; stand tall.

name: Pause squat
cues: Squat down and hold 3 seconds at the bottom without relaxing; then stand.

name: One-and-a-half squat
cues: Go all the way down, come halfway up, go back down, then stand fully: that is one rep.

name: Dumbbell goblet squat
cues: Hold one dumbbell upright at your chest, elbows down; squat between your knees; stand tall.

name: Kettlebell goblet squat
cues: Hold the kettlebell by the handle sides at your chest; squat between your knees; stand tall.

name: Band squat
cues: Stand on the band with the ends at your shoulders; squat down and stand up against the band.

name: Barbell back squat
cues: Bar across the upper back, brace your middle; squat to a depth you control and drive up; always set the safety bars.

name: Leg press
cues: Feet shoulder-width on the plate; lower until knees are bent about 90 degrees; press without snapping the knees straight.

name: Glute bridge
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat; squeeze your buttocks and lift hips until knees, hips and shoulders line up; lower slowly.

name: Single-leg glute bridge
cues: Like a glute bridge with one foot lifted; keep your hips level.

name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift (bodyweight)
cues: Stand on one leg with a soft knee; push hips back and reach toward the floor while the back leg rises; flat back; touch a wall for balance if needed.

name: Single-leg hip thrust (shoulders on couch)
cues: Upper back on a sturdy couch or bench edge, one foot on the floor; drive hips up and pause at the top.

name: Sliding hamstring curl
cues: Lie on your back, heels on a towel on a smooth floor; lift hips, pull heels toward you, then slide them out slowly.

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
cues: Dumbbells in front of your thighs, soft knees; push hips back with a flat back until the backs of your legs stretch; stand by squeezing your buttocks.

name: Kettlebell deadlift
cues: Kettlebell between your feet; hips back, flat back, grip it and stand up tall; lower with control.

name: Kettlebell swing
cues: Hike the bell back between your legs and snap your hips forward so it floats to chest height; arms stay relaxed; it is a hip movement, not a squat.

name: Band pull-through
cues: Band anchored low behind you and held between your legs; push hips back, then stand tall by squeezing your buttocks.

name: Dumbbell hip thrust
cues: Upper back on the bench, dumbbell on your hips over a folded towel; drive hips up and pause at the top.

name: Barbell Romanian deadlift
cues: Bar in front of your thighs, soft knees; push hips back with a flat back to just below the knees; stand tall.

name: Supported split squat
cues: One hand on a wall or chair, feet a long stride apart; lower the back knee toward the floor and push up through the front foot.

name: Split squat
cues: Feet a long stride apart, hands on hips; lower the back knee toward the floor and push up through the front foot.

name: Reverse lunge
cues: Step back, lower the back knee toward the floor, then push through the front foot to return.

name: Rear-foot-elevated split squat
cues: Back foot on a chair or couch, front foot well forward; lower straight down and push up through the front foot.

name: Skater squat
cues: Stand on one leg and bend the other knee behind you; lower until the back knee touches a cushion; stand up.

name: Box pistol squat
cues: Stand on one leg in front of a chair, other leg forward; sit down slowly and stand up on one leg.

name: Dumbbell reverse lunge
cues: A dumbbell in each hand at your sides; step back, lower the back knee, push through the front foot to return.

name: Dumbbell step-up
cues: Put the whole foot on a sturdy bench or step; stand up tall; step down slowly.

name: Kettlebell goblet split squat
cues: Hold the kettlebell at your chest, feet a long stride apart; lower the back knee and push up through the front foot.

name: Wall push-up
cues: Hands on the wall at shoulder height, body straight; bend your elbows to bring your chest to the wall; push away.

name: High incline push-up
cues: Hands on a kitchen counter, body straight from head to heels; lower your chest to the edge; push away.

name: Knee push-up
cues: Knees on a cushion, body straight from head to knees; lower your chest near the floor; push up.

name: Low incline push-up (hands about 30 cm up)
cues: Hands on a sturdy step or low box about 30 cm (one foot) high, body straight; lower your chest to the edge; push away. Lower than a chair seat, so it is harder than the knee push-up.

name: Push-up
cues: Hands a bit wider than shoulders, body straight, elbows at about 45 degrees; chest near the floor; push up.

name: Feet-elevated push-up
cues: Feet on a chair or step, body straight; lower your chest near the floor; push up.

name: Archer push-up
cues: Hands wide; lower toward one hand while the other arm stays nearly straight; push up; switch sides.

name: Wall push-up on fists
cues: Like a wall push-up but on closed fists with straight wrists; kind to sore wrists.

name: Band chest press
cues: Band around your upper back, one end in each hand; press both hands forward to straight arms; return slowly.

name: Dumbbell floor press
cues: Lie on the floor, knees bent; press the dumbbells up from where your upper arms touch the floor.

name: Dumbbell bench press
cues: Lie on the bench, feet on the floor; lower the dumbbells to chest level; press up.

name: Barbell bench press
cues: Shoulder blades pulled back, feet planted; lower the bar to mid-chest and press; use safety bars or a spotter.

name: Machine chest press
cues: Handles at mid-chest height; press forward to straight arms; return slowly.

name: Elevated pike push-up
cues: Hands on a sturdy chair, hips high in an upside-down V; bend your elbows to bring your head toward the seat; push back up.

name: Pike push-up
cues: Hands on the floor, hips high in an upside-down V; lower the top of your head toward the floor; push back up.

name: Feet-elevated pike push-up
cues: Feet on a chair, hips high, hands on the floor; lower your head toward the floor; push back up.

name: Band overhead press
cues: Stand on the band, hands at your shoulders; press overhead without leaning back; lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell overhead press
cues: Seated or standing with dumbbells at your shoulders; press up until your arms are straight, ribs down; lower slowly.

name: Kettlebell one-arm press
cues: Kettlebell resting on your forearm at the shoulder; press straight up without leaning; lower slowly.

name: Barbell overhead press
cues: Bar at your collarbones, squeeze your buttocks and brace; press straight up, head through at the top.

name: Prone Y-T raise
cues: Lie face down, forehead on a towel; lift your arms in a Y then a T by squeezing your shoulder blades together; lower slowly.

name: Table row (inverted row), knees bent
cues: Only under a very sturdy table: lie under the edge and grip it, knees bent and heels down; pull your chest to the table with a straight body. Before every set, test the table: lean your full weight on the edge; if it tips, slides or wobbles, do not use it and do the Y-T raise or a band row instead.

name: Table row (inverted row), legs straight
cues: As the bent-knee table row with legs straight; body stays in one line. Before every set, test the table: lean your full weight on the edge; if it tips, slides or wobbles, do not use it and do the Y-T raise or a band row instead.

name: Table row (inverted row), feet raised
cues: As the straight-leg table row with heels on a chair. Before every set, test the table: lean your full weight on the edge; if it tips, slides or wobbles, do not use it and do the Y-T raise or a band row instead.

name: One-arm dumbbell row
cues: One hand and knee on a bench or chair, back flat; pull the dumbbell toward your hip; lower slowly.

name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
cues: Lie chest-down on an inclined bench; row both dumbbells to your lower ribs; lower slowly.

name: Band row
cues: Band anchored in a door at chest height (or sit with legs straight and the band around your feet); pull elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.

name: Kettlebell bent-over row
cues: Free hand on a chair, back flat; pull the kettlebell toward your hip; lower slowly.

name: Seated cable row
cues: Sit tall, chest up; pull the handle to your lower ribs; let your arms straighten slowly.

name: Band pull-apart
cues: Hold a band at shoulder height with straight arms; pull it apart until it touches your chest; return slowly.

name: Dead hang
cues: Hang from the bar with straight arms and shoulders active, not shrugged to your ears; step down, don't drop.

name: Scapular pull-up
cues: From a dead hang, pull your shoulder blades down and back so your body rises a little; arms stay straight.

name: Flexed-arm hang
cues: Step up so your chin is over the bar and hold there with elbows bent; step down.

name: Negative pull-up
cues: Step up to chin over the bar, then lower yourself slowly over 3-5 seconds to straight arms; step back up for the next rep.

name: Band-assisted pull-up
cues: Loop a band over the bar and under one knee or foot; pull your chest toward the bar; lower with control; use a lighter band over time.

name: Chin-up
cues: Palms facing you, shoulder-width; pull until your chin clears the bar; lower all the way.

name: Pull-up
cues: Palms facing away, a little wider than shoulders; pull until your chin clears the bar; lower all the way.

name: Weighted pull-up
cues: Wear a dip belt, or a backpack with a dumbbell packed tight; same as a pull-up; add weight in small steps.

name: Floor lat pull
cues: Lie face down with arms overhead just off the floor; pull your elbows down to your ribs as if doing a pull-up; squeeze and return.

name: Band lat pulldown
cues: Band anchored high in a door or over a pull-up bar; sit on a chair or kneel and pull your hands down to your chest, elbows to your sides.

name: Lat pulldown machine
cues: Thighs under the pad; pull the bar to your upper chest, elbows down; let it rise slowly.

name: Assisted pull-up machine
cues: Kneel on the pad; pull your chin over the handles; use less assistance over time.

name: Dead bug
cues: Lie on your back, arms up, knees over hips; slowly lower one arm and the opposite leg while your lower back stays on the floor.

name: Knee plank
cues: Forearms and knees on the floor, body straight from head to knees; breathe normally.

name: Plank
cues: Forearms and toes on the floor, body straight, buttocks squeezed; breathe normally.

name: Hollow body hold
cues: Lie on your back, lower back pressed down; lift shoulders and legs a little off the floor; bend knees to make it easier.

name: Body saw
cues: Forearm plank with feet on a towel on a smooth floor; slide your body back and forward a little without sagging.

name: Side plank on knees
cues: On one forearm with knees bent, lift your hips so your body is straight from head to knees.

name: Side plank
cues: On one forearm with legs straight, lift your hips so your body is straight from head to feet.

name: Bird dog
cues: On hands and knees, reach one arm and the opposite leg long; hold 2 seconds without twisting; switch.

name: Band Pallof press
cues: Band anchored at chest height to your side; press your hands straight out and resist the twist; bring them back.

name: Suitcase carry
cues: Hold one heavy dumbbell at your side; walk tall without leaning for the set time; switch hands.

name: Band biceps curl
cues: Stand on the band; elbows by your sides; curl your hands to your shoulders; lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell biceps curl
cues: Elbows by your sides; curl the dumbbells up without swinging; lower slowly.

name: Band triceps pushdown
cues: Band anchored high; elbows pinned to your sides; push your hands down to straight arms; return slowly.

name: Dumbbell overhead triceps extension
cues: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands; lower it behind your head by bending the elbows; straighten.

name: Chair dip
cues: Hands on the edge of a sturdy chair behind you, knees bent; lower until elbows are about 90 degrees; push up.

name: High wall sit
cues: Back flat against a wall, feet a step forward and hip-width; slide down only a little, to a height that feels easy on your knees; hold and breathe; slide back up.

name: Supported split-squat hold
cues: One hand on a wall or chair, feet a long stride apart; bend both knees only a little and hold; keep the front foot flat; switch sides.

name: Door-frame row
cues: Stand facing an open door frame and hold both sides at chest height; feet just in front of the frame, lean back a little with straight arms; pull your chest to the frame and lower slowly. Keep the lean small: step your feet back to make it easier.

name: Wall hip hinge
cues: Stand a foot-length in front of a wall, soft knees; push your hips back until your buttocks touch the wall, back flat; stand tall by squeezing your buttocks.

name: Supported single-leg Romanian deadlift
cues: One hand on a chair back or counter; stand on one leg with a soft knee; push your hips back and lean forward while the other leg rises behind you; flat back; stand tall.

name: Standing wall plank
cues: Forearms on a wall at shoulder height, feet stepped back, body straight from head to heels; breathe normally.

name: Counter plank
cues: Forearms on a sturdy kitchen counter or table edge, feet stepped back, body straight from head to heels; breathe normally.

name: Tandem stance at a counter
cues: Stand next to a kitchen counter, one foot directly in front of the other (heel to toe); hands hover over the counter; touch it whenever you need; switch feet halfway.

name: Single-leg stand at a counter
cues: Stand next to a kitchen counter on one leg, hands hovering over it; touch it whenever you need; switch legs.

name: Single-leg stand with a slow reach
cues: Next to a kitchen counter, stand on one leg and slowly reach the free hand forward, then to the side; touch the counter whenever you need; switch legs.

name: Heel-to-toe walk along a counter
cues: Walk slowly along a kitchen counter, putting the heel of one foot right in front of the toes of the other; one hand hovers over the counter; turn and walk back.

name: Step-up onto a low step
cues: Use a stair or a sturdy step about shin height with a wall or rail in reach; put your whole foot on the step, push through that heel to stand up tall, then step down slowly.

name: Step-up onto a knee-high step
cues: Use a sturdy step or bench about knee height, never a chair that can tip; lean forward a little, drive through the heel on the step and stand tall, then lower yourself slowly without pushing off the back foot.

name: Standing hip abduction at a counter
cues: Stand tall holding a counter; keep your toes pointing forward and lift one leg out to the side without leaning, then lower it slowly.

name: Side-lying hip abduction
cues: Lie on your side with your head on your arm and the bottom knee bent; keep the top leg straight and in line with your body, toes forward, lift it to just above hip height, then lower it slowly.

name: Band seated hip abduction
cues: Sit at the front of a chair with a loop band just above your knees; push your knees out against the band, hold a moment, then let them come back slowly.
